---
name: write-tests
description: Write or update automated tests for new or changed code. Use when adding features, fixing bugs, or when asked to improve test coverage.
---

# Write Tests

## Steps
1. Find the existing test framework, layout, and naming conventions; reuse them.
2. Cover the happy path, edge cases, and failure modes of the changed behavior.
3. For bug fixes, write a failing test that reproduces the bug first.
4. Keep tests independent, deterministic, and free of real network or secrets.
5. Run the tests and confirm they pass.
